reason: Net-additive defect fix (task 6300): GitOps.own_delta_upstream lets train failure attribution cut a still-stacked anchor's solo above its unlanded stack base, so a pre-6133 train's anchor can no longer land a never-landed predecessor's commits under its own name. The foreign-cut computation is extracted from _unstack_recorded into GitOps._foreign_cut so both share it. Not a refactor that failed.
